description: Validate an existing e-invoice file without changing it. Accepts UBL Invoice/CreditNote XML, UN/CEFACT CII XML, FatturaPA or KSeF FA(3) XML, or a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X/XRechnung PDF. Returns verdict, findings and rule set versions. Checks: XRechnung 3.0 (UBL, CII), EN 16931 (UBL, CII), Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (UBL), Netherlands NLCIUS (SI-UBL 2.0, CII), Romania CIUS-RO, French CIUS rules when country is FR, and ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF or CII in all profiles (MINIMUM, BASIC WL, BASIC, EN16931, EXTENDED). Other EN 16931 CIUS are checked against the EN 16931 core rules only, and the result notes that national rules were not checked. Italy FatturaPA and Poland KSeF FA(3) are checked against the official schema only. A PDF is also checked as a PDF/A-3 container, but only if the PDF itself is sent. Checks an existing file; it does not create, convert or change invoices. B2B only. Requires the caller's own Electronic Invoice API key, sent either directly as Authorization: Bearer eia_live_... or through an OAuth 2.1 access token issued by this server. A call that reaches the API and returns 200, 400, 422 or 504 counts against the plan quota.

checks.description: Optional opt-in plausibility checks (PL rules): mandatory items of section 14(4) UStG, arithmetic, dates, Skonto, VAT rates, VAT id form. They are an aid, not legal or tax advice.

content.description: Raw invoice XML as UTF-8 text (UBL Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII). For XML invoices only. XML extracted from a PDF is checked without the PDF container; send PDFs through file or contentBase64. Exactly one of file, content and contentBase64 is required.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded raw bytes of an invoice XML or PDF file. For PDFs and binary-safe XML when file is not available. Exactly one of file, content and contentBase64 is required.

contentType.description: Optional MIME type of the supplied document. Defaults to application/xml for content and to a value derived from filename for contentBase64. Ignored for file, where the file content decides.

country.description: Rule set country. DE checks XRechnung and EN 16931. FR applies the French CIUS rules. Default DE.

file.description: The invoice file the user attached in ChatGPT. The server fetches the original bytes and passes them on unchanged, so a PDF is checked as a whole, including its container. Only for clients that provide file references. Exactly one of file, content and contentBase64 is required.

download_url.description: Temporary download URL provided by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name provided by ChatGPT.

mime_type.description: MIME type provided by ChatGPT. Not trusted, the file content decides.

filename.description: Optional original filename, for example rechnung.xml or rechnung.pdf. It is used only to derive the result filename and is not sent to the API.

name: validate_invoice
title: Validate e-invoice
